subtitles.text: Passage 2 Listening Exercise I will describe five out of the ten IT jobs you have learned.
Listen to the descriptions.
Choose which job I am describing and take a memo.
When you are ready, answer the questions in the quiz.
Please listen many times.
Number one.
I work at a big data center in California.
Every morning, I check the systems to make sure that the databases are running well and that there are no errors.
I also back Up the data so we don't lose important information.
During the day, I help other workers on my team if there is an error or when something is too slow.
I update the data.
Base when new information comes in, and I make small changes to improve speed and security.
I enjoy my work because I solve problems and I make sure everyone has the data.
Data they need.
Which job best matches the description of number one?
Choose from the ten jobs below and write down your Answer.
Number two Each morning I check our security tools.
To see if there were any unusual activities during the night.
I watch the network during the day to make sure no one is trying to break in.
When I see something strange, I investigate and decide what to do.
I also install updates and fix weak points so our systems stay strong.
Sometimes I teach other workers how to stay safe.
Safe online, like using strong passwords and not clicking unknown links.
I feel proud of my work because I help keep everyone's information secure.
Which job best matches description two?
Please write down your answer.
Number three My job is to make sure our software works well before we release it.
Each day I test new features to find bugs or problems.
I follow test plans, try different actions in the program, and write down anything that does not work correctly.
When I do find an issue, I report it to the developers so they can fix it.
I also check the fixes later to make sure the problems are really solved.
Sometimes I create simple options.
Automated tests to save time.
I enjoy my work because I help the team deliver software that is reliable and easy for people to use.
Which job best matches the description of number three?
Write down your answers.
Number four.
My job is to build and improve websites for our company.
Each morning I review my tasks and look at any feedback from designers or clients.
I write code to create new pages, I fix old parts, and I make the website look good on both smartphones and computers.
During the day, I test what I build to make sure everything loads quickly and works without errors.
I also talk with designers and other developers to understand what features we need next.
Sometimes I update the site to make it easier to use or more secure.
I enjoy my work because I can create things that people use every day.
Match the job to the description of number four.
Write down your answer.
Number five, my job is to design and build programs that help people do their work more easily.
Each day, I start by checking my tasks and reading any messages from my team.
I write code to add new features, fix bugs, and improve how the software runs.
During the day, I test my work to make sure everything functions correctly and does not slow down the system.
I also meet with other developers, designers, and testers to plan what we will build.
Next.
Sometimes I review other people's code to help them keep their projects clean and safe.
I enjoy my job because I can create useful tools and solve interesting problems.
Choose the job that matches the description of number five.
Write down your answer.
Did you understand what each job is?
If you are not sure, go back and listen again.
When you are ready, use the notes you took to answer the questions in the comprehension quiz.
Good luck and gambate.
